Class PromptRenderContext

java.lang.Object
tech.kayys.wayang.prompt.core.PromptRenderContext
public final class PromptRenderContext extends Object
============================================================================ PromptRenderContext — runtime resolution bag supplied by the Workflow Engine. ============================================================================ The Prompt Engine is deliberately source-agnostic: it does not know how values were produced. The Engine assembles a PromptRenderContext from the current NodeContext and hands it in. The VariableResolver then picks the right value for each variable based on PromptVariableDefinition.getSource(). Immutability ------------ All maps and lists exposed here are unmodifiable. The Engine constructs one via the PromptRenderContext.Builder and hands it to the Prompt Engine; the Prompt Engine never mutates it. Relationship to the platform ---------------------------- - inputs ← merged output of upstream node(s) - ragResults ← output of RAG Service retrieval (if configured) - memoryEntries← output of Agent Memory lookup (if configured) - environment ← read-only view of runtime config / env vars - secrets ← read-only view of resolved secrets (already decrypted) All five maps use the same key namespace as PromptVariableDefinition.getName().
